summary: libsodium crypto_box_seal (X25519 + XSalsa20-Poly1305) of a context-bound 72-byte package. Frozen; the bytes are identical to the wrapper used by vault-v2, script-execution/v1 and agent-submission/v1.

fingerprint.note: Legacy input without the suite id. It stays unchanged to keep existing fingerprints valid.

package.seal: crypto_box_seal(plaintext, recipientPublicKey) = ephemeralPublicKey[32] || crypto_box_easy(plaintext, nonce = BLAKE2b-192(ephemeralPublicKey || recipientPublicKey), recipientPublicKey, ephemeralPrivateKey)
package.open: Reject any package that is not exactly 120 bytes before calling crypto_box_seal_open. After opening, require the exact 72-byte length, the PLDNX2K1 magic and a constant-time match of the context hash of the independently built descriptor.

implementationNotes: Generate the ephemeral key pair with the platform CSPRNG; the deterministic ephemeral seed exists only in the fixture generator.
Wipe the opened plaintext and the context hash after use.
